1c.hook_script:
import json, os, sys
event = sys.argv[1]
raw = sys.stdin.read()
try:
    payload = json.loads(raw)
except ValueError:
    payload = None
rec = {"event": event, "t": __import__("time").time()}
if isinstance(payload, dict):
    rec["keys"] = sorted(payload)
    rt = payload.get("response_text")
    rec["response_text_len"] = len(rt) if isinstance(rt, str) else None
    rec["response_text_type"] = type(rt).__name__ if "response_text" in payload else None
    rec["has_parent_session_id"] = bool(payload.get("parent_session_id"))
    rec["agent_name"] = payload.get("agent_name")
    rec["hook_event_name"] = payload.get("hook_event_name")
    rec["turn_id_present"] = bool(payload.get("turn_id"))
else:
    rec["unparsed_len"] = len(raw)
with open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "hook-log.jsonl"), "a") as handle:
    handle.write(json.dumps(rec, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
